meta.title: Daymark
meta.description: Try Daymark in a throwaway WordPress. Opens the Daymark app with sample Marks and four sites already followed.
meta.author: jeffpaul

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Everything the preview shows (the followed sites, the sample Marks) is set
// up by one script, shared with the README demo and the pull request
// previews. The released plugin does not carry it, so an earlier step copied
// its folder here.
$demo = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/daymark-demo/set-up-demo.php';
if ( file_exists( $demo ) ) {
	require $demo;
}
